turns.input: *He looks at Bartolomhew, trying to understand what kind of person he has in front of him.*
turns.draft:
Bartolomhew stands easily in the square, his elegant clothing showing subtle clerical tailoring beneath a warm, assessing smile. His white-streaked blond hair catches the daylight, the retained tonsure a deliberate echo of a calling he no longer holds. He watches Nicco with the patient, welcoming gaze of a man accustomed to being approached, to sizing others up while offering nothing but courtesy in return.

The slaver's expression doesn't shift as Nicco studies him—merely settles into something more expectant, as if waiting to learn whether this tall, soft stranger has business worthy of his attention or will simply drift past like so many others through Heartstone Square.
